content.name: Priya Sandhu
content.title: Registered Nurse, General Medicine
content.summary: Newly registered nurse (CRNA) on an acute general medicine unit, with a final-year practicum in emergency and a summer as an Undergraduate Nursing Employee. Bilingual in English and Punjabi, which I use daily with patients and families from Calgary's South Asian community.

experience.title: Undergraduate Nursing Employee (UNE)
bullets: Worked under RN supervision on a 28-bed surgical unit, providing post-operative assessments, vital signs and wound care for up to 4 patients per shift.
Performed blood glucose monitoring and documented intake and output in Connect Care for 20+ diabetic and bariatric patients.
Created a laminated, picture-based mobility guide for post-op hip patients that the unit adopted for its patient whiteboards.

experience.title: Registered Nurse, General Medicine
bullets: Care for 5 patients per shift on a 34-bed medicine unit, including COPD exacerbations, heart failure and patients awaiting continuing care placement.
Completed the unit's 8-week new-graduate transition program and now independently manage IV therapy, PICC line care and blood transfusions.
Interpret for Punjabi-speaking patients during consent and discharge teaching, supporting roughly 15 families a month alongside formal interpreter services.
Joined the unit's delirium prevention working group and help audit CAM screening, which rose from 62% to 84% completion over two quarters.

education.details: Final practicum: 300 hours in an adult emergency department. Dean's List 2023 and 2024.

courses.name: Basic Life Support (BLS) Provider
courses.provider: Heart and Stroke Foundation of Canada

achievements.title: Registered Nurse, CRNA
achievements.detail: Registered with the College of Registered Nurses of Alberta after passing the NCLEX-RN on the first attempt in 2025.

achievements.title: Volunteer, student-run health clinic
achievements.detail: Took blood pressure and screened 150+ visitors at a free community clinic over two years.
